title: Preceptor Aldous's dialogue option 'press him on the Hundred' lists its cost as 'a miss costs standing with the Ironbound,' implying success is free — but succeeding the check also applied '(the Ironbound -1)' alongside the success text, an unstated cost on the winning outcome.
where: The Ironbound Chapterhouse (Cinderhall) / 'press him on the Hundred' dialogue
